en: I heard the sound at night.
I didn't hear yesterday's news.
You heard the teacher's words.
You didn't hear the phone ringing.
You heard the new music yesterday.
You didn't hear the door knocking.
He heard the noise in the street.
He didn't hear the teacher well.
She heard the news on the radio.
She didn't hear his voice.
We heard the call to prayer at dawn.
We didn't hear the worker in the morning.
You heard what the director said.
You didn't hear our words well.
They heard the music from afar.
They didn't hear the sound of thunder.
I hear noise at night.

lat: ma kansme3sh mezyan f had l-bit
en: I don't hear well in this room.
You listen to songs in the car.
You don't listen to people's words.
You hear the boy's crying.
You don't hear what I tell you.
He listens to the news every morning.
He doesn't listen to anyone's words.
She listens to music in the kitchen.

lat: hiya ma katsme3sh s-sda3 f d-dar
en: She doesn't hear the noise in the house.
We hear the sound of the sea.
We don't hear the phone when it rings.
You hear the teacher in the classroom.
You don't listen to the parents' advice.
They listen to music every evening.
They don't hear the dog barking.
I am going to listen to music at home.

lat: ma ghadish nsme3 had l-hadra tani
ar: ما غاديش نسمع هاد الهضرة تاني
en: I am not going to hear this talk again.
You will hear the news on the TV.

lat: ma ghadish tsme3 walu mn hna
ar: ما غاديش تسمع والو من هنا
en: You will not hear anything from here.
You will hear his voice tomorrow.

lat: ma ghadish tsem3i s-sda3 f l-lil
en: You will not hear the noise at night.
He will listen to your story tomorrow.
He will not listen to the director's words.
She will listen to music with us today.

lat: ma ghadish tsme3 l-hadra dyalhum tani
ar: ما غاديش تسمع الهضرة ديالهم تاني
en: She will not listen to their talk again.
We will hear the sermon in the mosque.

lat: ma ghadish nsem3u walu f had l-bit
ar: ما غاديش نسمعو والو فهاد البيت
en: We will not hear anything in this room.
You (pl.) will hear the teacher in the meeting.

lat: ma ghadish tsem3u s-sowt dyal l-b7er
ar: ما غاديش تسمعو الصوت ديال البحر
en: You will not hear the sound of the sea.
They will listen to songs at the party.

lat: ma ghadish ysem3u l-bab mn l-kuzina
ar: ما غاديش يسمعو الباب من الكوزينة
en: They will not hear the door from the kitchen.
